# Spec inventories (tables and lists that enumerate what code defines) that no
# test compares with the code. Each line names the heading that holds one:
# `path ## heading text`, or `path:anchor` where a page repeats the heading text.
# TestDocsUnheldInventoriesExist fails when a listed heading no longer exists,
# so remove a line when its table is held by a test or leaves the specs. The
# list cannot see a new unheld inventory; a reviewer does.
